overview: The Beast-Handling Yards Interior is where Vah Shir hunters train, care for, and bond with their beasts. Clan handlers oversee beast discipline, integration, and ceremonial rites.
history: The yards were built as the first beast-training facility in Shar Vahl.
Clan handlers developed standardized beast-care and integration rituals.
Arcane stabilizers were added to manage beast-energy interactions.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, the yards were expanded and reinforced.
Beast-integration drills became a core part of hunter training.
hooks: A beast breaks free during integration drills.
Arcane stabilizers overload during a bonding ritual.
Supply storage collapses, agitating nearby beasts.
